questions.question: ________ is the youngest recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option **4** i.e __**Abhinav Bindra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna now named Major Dhyanchand Khel Ratna Award is the highest sports award in India.
 
 
• Award is named after Rajiv Gandhi, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
• Awarded by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Instituted in **1991**.
 
• **Viswanathan Anand** is the first recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award.
 
• Sport shooter Abhinav Bindra is the youngest recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award.
 
• Last awarded in 2019.
 
• Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award winners 2019:** Deepa Malik and Bajrang Punia**.

• Shri Gukesh D (Chess)
 
• Shri Harmanpreet Singh (Hockey)
 
• Shri Praveen Kumar (Para‑Athletics)
 
• Ms. Manu Bhaker (Shooting)

questions.question: Who is the first Indian to be awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman**__.

__
 
• India's first physicist to win a** Nobel** **Physics Prize in 1930,** for his work on the **scattering of light**.
 
• The discovery of the effect was named after him** (Raman Effect)**.
 
• He further established that a small portion of the scattered light acquires other wavelengths than that of the original light because some of the incoming **photons' energy** can be transferred to a molecule, giving it a higher level of energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 Har Gobind Khorana
 
 
 
• His work on electron diffraction got him the 1968 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
 
• He shared the award with Robert W Holley and Marshall W Nirenberg for their interpretation of the genetic code and its function in protein synthesis.
 
 
 
 

 Subramanyan Chandrasekhar
 
 
 
• In 1983, he bagged the Nobel Prize in Physics for theoretical studies of the physical processes of importance to the structure and evolution of the stars.
 
• He shared the award with another physicist William Alfred Fowler.
 
• His theory suggested that the star further collapses into a compact star known as a white dwarf.
 
 
 
 

 Venkatraman Ramakrishnan
 
 
 
• He received the 2009 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for studies of the structure and function of the ribosome.
 
• He shared the award with Thomas A Steitz and Ada E Yonath.

__**Dronacharya Award**__

__
 
• The Republic of India's highest honour for sports coaching is the **Dronacharya Award**, also known as the** Dronacharya Award for Distinguished Coaches in Sports and Games.**
 
• **The honour bears the name Drona, often known as "Dronacharya" or "Guru Drona,**" a figure from the ancient Indian Sanskrit epic Mahabharata.
 
• **He was designated as the princes of Kaurava and Pandava for their instruction in military arts and astras since he was a ****Master of Modern Military** combat (Divine weapons).
 
• **The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports bestows it annually.**

Dhyan Chand Lifetime Achievement Award __​

__
 
• **Dhyan Chand Lifetime Achievement Award** **Pays** honour to **athletes** who have improved sports via their performances and who still support sports even after they have retired from competitive athletics.

 Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy__

__
 
• The **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy**, sometimes referred to as the **MAKA Trophy**, is a sporting honour bestowed by the Indian Republic. For having the best overall athletic performance in competitions organised at the **inter-university, national, and international level**s, the award is granted to** Indian universities.**

Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar__

 
• The "**Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar**" is awarded to business organisations (both in the public and private sectors), **sports control boards, NGOs, and national and state sports organisations** that have made a significant contribution to the growth and promotion of sports.

questions.question: APJ Abdul Kalam was awarded the Bharat Ratna in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__1997__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was an Indian Aerospace scientist and an awardee of the Bharat Ratna award in 1997.
 
• He was the **11th President of India from 2002-2007.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India.
 
• Bharat Ratna was introduced on 2nd January 1954.
 
• The first three recipients of Bharat Ratna - C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, and C. V. Raman.
 
• The first person to receive Bharat Ratna - C. Rajagopalachari.
 
• The first scientist to receive Bharat Ratna - C. V. Raman (1954).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Bharat Ratna is awarded in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavour.
 
• The recommendations for Bharat Ratna are made by the Prime Minister himself to the President.
 
• The original specifications for the award called for a circular gold medal, 35 mm in diameter, with the sun and the Hindi legend "Bharat Ratna" above and a floral wreath below. The reverse was to carry the state emblem and motto. It is to be worn around the neck with a white ribbon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7125df9df566bf36a13c046048cc9ad91af503f114916700903ff26729f8c040.png]

questions.question: Amrita Devi Bishnoi award is given for
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __wildlife protection.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Amrita Devi Bishnoi Award is given to the people for their courage and dedication to protecting wildlife.
 
• In 1731, the king of Jodhpur in Rajasthan asked one of his ministers to arrange wood for constructing a new palace.
 
• The minister and workers went to a forest near a village, inhabited by Bishnois, to cut down trees.
 
• The Bishnoi community is known for its peaceful co-existence with nature.
 
• The effort to cut down trees by the kings was thwarted by the Bishnois.
 
• A Bishnoi woman Amrita Devi showed exemplary courage by hugging a tree and daring the king’s men to cut her first before cutting the tree.
 
• The tree mattered much more to her than her own life.

questions.question: In which year was the Tagore Ratna and Tagore Awards instituted by the Sangeet Natak Akademi for contribution to the performing arts in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2012.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi **Tagore Ratna** and Sangeet Natak Akademi **Tagore Puraskar** were given at special events organized by Sangeet Natak Akademi in

 
 
• **Kolkata – Sangeet Natak Akademi Tagore Samman on 25 April 2012**
 
• **Chennai – Sangeet Natak Akademi Tagore Samman on 2 May 2012**
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Tagore Ratna is original to Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship **and **Sangeet Natak Akademi Tagore Puruskar is original to Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• These were one-time awards conferred on the occasion to **commemorate the 150 birthday of Rabindranath Tagore**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore:**

 
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was the man who gave India, its **National Anthem.**
 
• He was one of the topmost realities of all time and the only Indian to admit a** **Nobel Prize**.**
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was awarded the **Nobel Prize in 1913,** getting the first non-European to admit the honor.
 
• He was only sixteen years old when he was to publish his first short story called **“ Bhanisimha ”**, was published.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore entered his surname “ Gurudev ”, out of respect by his pupils at his veritably unique and special academy, which he established in Shantiniketan, called “ Visva Bharati University ” **Santiniketan** was developed and innovated by the Tagore family.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi:**
 
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi, the** apex body** in the field of performing trades in the country, was set up in **1953 **for the preservation and creation of the vast impalpable heritage of India’s different cultures expressed in forms of music, cotillion, and drama.
 
• The operation of the Akademi vests in its General Council.
 
• The** Chairman of the Akademi is appointed by the President of India for a term of five year.**
 
• The listing office of the Akademi is at Rabindra Bhavan, 35 Feroze Shah Road, New Delhi.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi is an independent body of the** Ministry of Culture**, Government of India.
